name: Otter.ai

bestFor: Meeting notes when everyone already talks on Zoom

summary: A meeting notetaker. Useful. Also a consent problem if you surprise the room.
body: Otter and its clones (Fireflies, Fathom) are how 2026 meetings become searchable. Tell the room. If you cannot, do not install it. Minute caps are the upsell. Site reviewed 16 Sep 2026.
notes: Export notes; do not treat Otter as a system of record
Fathom is a common free alternative for some users
